reasons: Direction check is correct: Section 7.2 places the MFN obligation on Customer (we must offer Vendor terms no less favourable than the best given to any other technology supplier), which is exactly the burden the rule targets rather than a Vendor-granted MFN.

The clause is unqualified as to product, term, and comparability, matching the walk-away position, so full deletion is the appropriate and minimal edit to reach the preferred position (no MFN burdening Customer); nothing Vendor-granted is lost.
Redline is valid and self-consistent: the entire obligation is removed with no orphaned text or cross-reference left behind.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice and prefix, states what changed and why, cites the playbook position, and offers the narrow 12-month/defined-product fallback.
